messages:
Maya Patel: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need owners, deadlines, and handoff notes for the remediation items. I sketched tickets below, please claim or reassign. Keep replies short so I can update the tracker.

Maya Patel: Items I captured:
- autoscaler double-scaling race -> INF-3500
- nightly batch job overload -> ENG-240
- flaky integration test suite -> INF-3501
- rollback playbook + tabletop -> RUN-10
Who takes what?

Ethan Brooks: I'll take INF-3500 (autoscaler). Plan: triage today, small patch by Tue EOD, canary Thu. Adding notes to ticket.

Riley Park: ENG-240 sounds like infra ownership. I'll own discovery and will look at cron and resource spikes. ETA: discovery 5 working days, then propose mitigation.

Noah Gomez: INF-3501 assign to me. I'll pair with QA and aim to quarantine flaky tests this sprint. Will add a follow-up to add stable nightly gating.

Lina Ortiz: For RUN-10 (rollback/playbook), I can coordinate docs and run the tabletop. Suggest: doc draft by next Wed, tabletop in 2 weeks. Ops-bot, can you reserve a 90m slot?

ops-bot: Calendar placeholder created: 2026-04-12 15:00 UTC for TABLETOP: rollback-playbook. Reminders set.

Maya Patel: Thanks. Quick RACI proposal so events can move:
- INF-3500: R=Ethan, A=Maya, C=Riley/Noah, I=Platform
- ENG-240: R=Riley, A=Ops, C=Ethan, I=ServiceReliability
- INF-3501: R=Noah, A=Maya, C=QA(Lina), I=DevEx
- RUN-10: R=Lina, A=Ops, C=Maya/Noah, I=All
If you disagree, post changes now.

Ethan Brooks: Fine with INF-3500 RACI. I'll add a canary checklist and monitoring thresholds to the ticket.

Riley Park: ENG-240: small note 5 we should include historical cpu/mem correlation and batch job timing. Adding that to discovery card. Also proposing to tag the nightly job with `resource-intensive`.

Noah Gomez: INF-3501: I'll add flaky-test labels and a quarantine run in CI. Lina, can you own the QA acceptance criteria for the ticket?

Lina Ortiz: Yep, I'll define acceptance criteria: no flaky failures in 10 consecutive runs, add synthetic load test. Will post criteria to INF-3501 by EOD tomorrow.

Maya Patel: Good. Two coordination asks: 1) update your ticket with an ETA and the one-sentence handoff note (who to call if blocked) by EOD today, 2) add the `postmortem-action` label so PMs can track closure.

Ethan Brooks: INF-3500 done: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3500 5 patch branch ready, canary scheduled for Thu. Handoff: contact Ethan for infra access, contact Riley for kernel tweaks.

Riley Park: ENG-240 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-240 5 discovery in progress. Added heaps of metrics and job schedule. ETA for mitigation proposal: 2026-04-20.

Noah Gomez: INF-3501 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3501 5 quarantining 3 tests now, CI gating plan in ticket.

Lina Ortiz: RUN-10 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RUN-10 5 draft runbook link added and ops-bot tabled the drill.

Maya Patel: One more pattern note: I looked at incidents and saw a fortnightly recurrence pattern that maps to the nightly job plus low-memory node churn. Riley, please include node churn analysis in ENG-240. If it's a root cause we can close INF-3500 as mitigation.

Riley Park: Will add node churn correlation graphs to ENG-240. If batch job is primary, plan shifts to scheduling window + backoff.

Noah Gomez: Small procedural ask: can we add an explicit handoff checklist before closing any ticket? E.g., docs updated, runbook note, owner for monitoring.

Maya Patel: Agreed. New closure checklist: owner confirms docs, runbook entry, monitoring alert with OK thresholds, and @mentions 2 reviewers. Put in a ticket template.

Lina Ortiz: I'll update the RUN ticket template and push to the `postmortem-templates` repo.

Maya Patel: OK, final next steps I will track: owners to confirm ETAs in tickets today, weekly sync on Friday channel thread until all have `closed` status. Thanks team. :v:
